mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, status, token_version FROM t_user WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (username, password_hash, nickname, role, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, 'user', 'active')
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET failed_login_attempts=0, locked_until=NULL WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status='active' ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id=p.permission_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=rp.role_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status='active' ORDER BY p.permission_code
